name: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck
description: A wide grip pulldown where the bar travels behind your neck. It works the lats and upper back but needs good shoulder mobility and control.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grip the bar wide with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Tilt your head slightly forward and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
